description: This file defines a custom exception class `DelinquencyBucketNotFoundException` used within the delinquency management component of the Fineract project. It extends a base exception class and provides static factory methods to generate exceptions with specific messages related to missing or nonexistent delinquency buckets.

classes.name: DelinquencyBucketNotFoundException
classes.description: Custom exception thrown when a delinquency bucket cannot be found, extending a platform-specific not found exception class.

methods.name: DelinquencyBucketNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with specific error codes and messages.

methods.name: notExist
methods.description: Static factory method to create an exception indicating the delinquency bucket with the given ID does not exist.

methods.name: notFound
methods.description: Static factory method to create an exception indicating the delinquency bucket with the given ID is not found.
